what_e0_did_not_settle: whether the printed 'Risk Premium' axis IS r_e or is added to a government bond rate — the patent labels the scenario axis Risk Premium but the equation symbol is 요구수익률
the numeric value or rule for g — the patent names 영구성장률 as an operand but the reviewed text does not print its value

whether the 2018 published reports used 수학식 1 unchanged, or an evolved multi-year form. [0074] describes a 2018-2023 assumed ROE path and figures 11a/11b split a consensus portion from a post-consensus portion, which is not visibly reconcilable with a strictly single-stage equation. The 2018 report matrices must settle this, not the patent text.
patent drawings: figure images beyond 수학식 1 returned HTTP 403 at the same storage path. E0 is bounded to one pass and is closed; no further OCR routes will be attempted.
e0_result.bounded_probe_disclosed_for_honesty: Before writing this freeze I ran one feasibility probe on the NASDAQ 2018 matrix quoted in the evidence audit to check whether the single-stage form is even arithmetically admissible. Under the audit's stated orientation it implies g of about 14.4-14.7 percent and is not self-consistent between adjacent cell pairs; transposed it implies about 8.5 percent. This probe chose no parameter, admitted no candidate and set no gate. It is recorded because it happened before the freeze, and because it is why the fixture schema demands the printed axis orientation be read off the page rather than assumed.

fixture_roles.rule: The split is declared here by a deterministic rule that cannot depend on any scoring outcome, because no candidate has been scored at freeze time.

holdout.selector: the NASDAQ 2020 forecast-year 3x3 from the 2018-07-18 report
holdout.why_this_one: it is the furthest-out forecast year in the index report, so it is the matrix least entangled with any prior project analysis, and its ROE centre differs most from the other two — a candidate that transfers to it has transferred across a real change in operands, not a rounding step

holdout.selector: among the complete 3x3 stock matrices transcribed from the 2018-04-09 report, the one whose asset name sorts last alphabetically
holdout.conditional: included in holdout only if E2 returns at least 8 complete matrices, so that TRAIN retains at least 5
holdout.why_this_rule: alphabetical order is independent of fit quality, so the choice cannot be steered by results

fixture_roles.train: every other complete matrix returned by E2
fixture_roles.hard_rule: No holdout matrix may be passed to any parameter-identification or family-selection routine. A parameter that does not transfer to holdout is evidence against the candidate, never an invitation to refit.
